lines.text: Many learners say: I am living here since 2020.
Better: I have lived here since 2020.
With since, use have lived, not am living.
Have lived! I have lived here since May.

data.why: With since, use have lived, not am living.

native.tip: हिंदी में “2020 से रह रहा हूँ” कहते हैं, पर अंग्रेज़ी में since के साथ “have lived” आता है।
native.caption: क्या आप भी कहते हैं “I am living here since 2020”? 😉 अंग्रेज़ी में “I have lived here since 2020” सही है, क्योंकि since के साथ “have lived” या “have been living” आता है, “am living” नहीं। Carlos की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “have lived”। “am living” की जगह “have lived” बोलें। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Learners often use am living with since; in English use have lived.
en.caption: Do you say “I am living here since 2020”? 😉 In English “I have lived here since 2020” is right, because since goes with have lived or have been living, not am living. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
